title: Vehicle pack UI layout
description: A pack's layout.json, served as VehiclePack.layout in GET /pack. Permissive on purpose: the keys below are checked where present, and a pack may add keys its custom views read (UI spec §5.3). New platform-level keys should be added here; pack-private ones are better prefixed x-.

driver_side.description: The side the driver sits on (right for a right-hand-drive vehicle). Landscape layouts put the navigation rail on this side; the kiosk flag side= overrides it, and the rail is on the left when it is absent (UI spec §3.3).

group_order.description: Order of signal groups on the Inputs page.

drive.description: Per-module Drive view: module id to a view.

kind.description: tiles, or a custom view type a pack registers.
